title: Identity overview — header loop

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Condense a system into a short recurring sequence so a viewer can recognize its character before studying its rules.
strategic_value: Alternating branded layouts and experiential footage can introduce Audi as both a digital system and a lived experience.
demonstration: The 14.44-second header loop cuts between website layouts, driving and human-detail footage, ending with rings over an aerial landscape.
practical_value: Compare a short introduction with the complete explanatory film AU01.

content_islands.name: Application flashes
content_islands.spec: Place briefly changing layouts and headlines across the frame.

content_islands.name: Experiential montage
content_islands.spec: Follow with action, vehicle and human-detail shots.

content_islands.name: Ring closure
content_islands.spec: Resolve to rings over the aerial landscape before repeating.

reference_purposes.Expression: The loop pairs Audi layouts with fast experiential imagery and a ring reveal.
reference_purposes.Application: It is the source page’s autoplay header presentation.
